description: This file defines types and helper functions for WebRTC client signaling messages, such as request offers and ICE candidates, in the context of a WebRTC client implementation.

methods.name: NewRequestOfferMsg
methods.description: Creates a new request offer message with specified ICE servers.

methods.name: NewICECandidateMsg
methods.description: Creates a new ICE candidate message with the given ICE candidate information.

methods.name: Reshape
methods.description: Converts a generic JSON object into a specific typed message, used for deserialization.
